title: Enterprise Resource Planning Specialist
description:
Company Overview:
Req ID: 379295
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
We are currently seeking a Enterprise Resource Planning Specialist to join our team in Westchester, Illinois (US-IL), United States (US).

Job Description:
Job Description - Enterprise Resource Planning Specialist
Role
The SAP Project Systems (PS) Lead will serve as the functional workstream lead responsible for the end-to-end delivery of the SAP PS solution. The role will drive solution design, lead business workshops, configure SAP PS, coordinate cross-functional integration, support testing, and ensure successful deployment of a standardized global project financial management solution.
Day to Day job Duties:
Solution Responsibility: (Design Phase 9 weeks)
Lead the SAP PS workstream throughout the project lifecycle.
Facilitate discovery and blueprint workshops with Finance, PMO, Engineering, Procurement, and regional business teams.
Define the global SAP PS template, including project profiles, coding masks, WBS structures, budgeting, and governance.
Ensure alignment of the SAP PS solution with business objectives and SAP best practices.
Functional Design & Configuration
Configure SAP Project System functionality, including:
Project Definition
Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
Project Profiles
Project Coding Masks
Network integration (where applicable)
Budget Management
Availability Control
Cost Planning
Commitment Management
Settlement Rules
Project Status Management
Prepare Functional Specifications for RICEFW developments.
Review technical developments to ensure compliance with functional.
Integration
Coordinate SAP PS integration with
SAP FI/CO (cost postings, settlements, financial reporting)
SAP MM (procurement and WBS-based purchasing)
Asset Accounting (Asset Under Construction and capitalization)
SAP Ariba (North America procurement integration)
Central Finance (cFIN) for WBS and financial posting replication
GCP Analytics Platform
Power BI reporting
Data Migration
Define migration strategy for existing projects and WBS structures.
Validate project master data and financial balances.
Support migration rehearsals and reconciliation activities.
Reporting & Analytics
Define SAP PS reporting requirements.
Support Power BI dashboard requirements and KPI definitions.
Validate reporting outputs against business expectations.
Basic Qualifications: (what are the skills required for this job with minimum years of experience on each)
Minimum 8+ years of overall SAP functional consulting experience
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on SAP Project Systems (PS) experience
Minimum 2 full-cycle SAP implementation projects as SAP PS Consultant/Lead
At least 1 global SAP S/4HANA implementation or transformation project
Minimum 2+ years of experience leading workshops, solution design, and business process discussions.
Experience in integration with FI/CO, MM, Asset Accounting, and procurement processes
Experience supporting data migration, testing, cutover, and hyper care activities
Experience working with global stakeholders across Finance, PMO, Engineering, and Procurement functions
Preferred / Valuable Skills (Min 8+ Years )
Experience with SAP Activate methodology.
Ability to lead Fit-to-Standard workshops, process harmonization sessions, and stakeholder discussions.
Lead SAP PS workstreams in S/4HANA transformation programs.
Own end-to-end Project-to-Cash (P2C) processes.
Mentor consultants and review solution designs.
Serve as the escalation point for PS-related issues.
Nice to Have; (But not necessary)
Engineering Degree

title: SailPoint Developer with PowerShell Experience
description:

We are currently seeking a SailPoint Developer with PowerShell Experience to join our team in Halifax, Nova Scotia (CA-NS), Canada (CA).

Job Description:
Day-to-Day Job Duties:
(What this person will do on a daily/weekly basis)
  • Implement and configure SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) solutions across enterprise environments.
  • Integrate and manage connectors including JDBC, ServiceNow ServiceDesk, Web Service, Oracle eBusiness Suite, Workday, and Active Directory.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Active Directory operations such as domain lookups, attribute queries, API integrations, and password vault synchronization.
  • Expert in using SailPoint V3 API's for configurations, code promotions and automations
  • Hands on experience with using SailPoint utilities
  • Design, build, and manage identity lifecycle workflows and triggers within SailPoint ISC.

  • Diagnose and resolve connector and provisioning issues in IAM environments.
  • Collaborate closely with IAM, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with enterprise policies and standards.
  • Continuously optimize identity governance processes and automation for efficiency and scalability.
Basic Qualifications:
(What are the skills required for this job with minimum years of experience on each)
  • SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) Implementation: 4+ years of hands-on experience deploying and supporting SailPoint ISC solutions.
  • Connector Integration Experience: 3+ years working with connectors such as JDBC, ServiceNow, Web Services, Oracle eBusiness Suite, Workday, and Active Directory.
  • PowerShell Scripting: 3+ years of advanced scripting experience focused on Active Directory automation and API integrations.
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM): 4+ years of experience in IAM concepts including provisioning, lifecycle management, and access governance.
  • SailPoint Configuration: 3+ years working with workflows, triggers, Access Certifications, cloud rules, connector rules, and transforms.
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving: Proven experience diagnosing and resolving complex IAM and connector-related issues.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including security, infrastructure, and application owners.
Nice to Have (But Not Mandatory):
  • Experience with identity governance in multi-cloud or hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and general scripting/programming beyond PowerShell (e.g., Python, Java).
  • Prior experience with compliance frameworks (SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) and audit processes.
  • Understanding of password vault integrations (e.g., CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault).
  • SailPoint certifications or relevant IAM certifications.
  • Experience with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines for IAM deployments.
  • Knowledge of ITSM processes and tools beyond ServiceNow.

title: Helpdesk Associate
description:
NTT DATA's Client is seeking a Help desk Associate to join their team. This position will have the opportunity to work from home / remotely in Halifax. This position will be a part of our Provider Clinical Service Desk, as an agent primarily handling inbound customer calls. This is a call center environment in which we support our customers 24x7x365.

All candidates will have to be shift flexible. Shift work is required including nights, weekends, and/or holidays. Account specific training is conducted during day shift hours, regardless of assigned shift.
Respond to incoming service desk calls from healthcare customers regarding the clinical aspects of various clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, McKesson and Meditech. Incidents may include, but are not limited to workflow issues, application errors, user access, and functionality.

Job Duties:

  • Track and document the appropriate comments, and close or escalate the incident tickets and related issues in a timely manner
  • Responsible for driving resolution of incidents on a 24/7 desk
  • Read text on computer screens for the duration of the shift
  • Remain at designated workspace and in the phone queue for an 8 to10-hour period with scheduled breaks
  • Ensure a quiet, private workspace with high speed, wired internet
  • Travel up to 10% of the time, if required
  • Lift up to 25 lbs. if needed for equipment setup
  • Have a working cell phone for manager communication and Two-Factor Authentication


Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 2 years of service desk / helpdesk experience or equivalent combination of education and technical troubleshooting experience (i.e., 2 years of work experience and 2 years of technical education)
  • Minimum of 1 year of technical troubleshooting experience
  • High school diploma or equivalent required


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in a call center environment
  • Demonstrate a service philosophy in all interactions with clinicians and colleagues
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong listening capabilities to fully understand caller's needs / requests
  • Exceptional ability to work optimally in a fast-paced environment

title: Collibra Engineer
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

Onsite position in any of the following locations (Plano, TX, Westlake, TX, Nashville, TN, New Hampshire)

Job Description:

NTT DATA is seeking a Collibra expert to support enterprise data governance initiatives for a large-scale client environment. This role is focused on hands-on implementation and configuration of Collibra, working closely with data governance stakeholders, stewards, and platform teams to operationalize cataloging, stewardship, lineage, and policy workflows.

The ideal candidate brings strong tool-level expertise in Collibra, experience working in enterprise data governance programs, and the ability to translate governance requirements into effective Collibra configurations.

Key Responsibilities
  • Collibra Implementation & Configuration
  • Configure and support Collibra Data Catalog capabilities including data assets, domains, communities, and operating models.
  • Implement and manage business glossaries, stewardship assignments, and certification workflows to establish trust in enterprise data assets.
  • Configure Collibra workflows (out-of-the-box and customized) to support governance, stewardship, and approval processes.
  • Support metadata curation and enrichment, including linking technical metadata, business terms, policies, and processes.
  • Lineage, Classification & Governance Enablement
  • Support technical and business lineage use cases by enabling visibility across source-to-report data flows.
  • Assist with data classification and tagging (including sensitive data where applicable) in alignment with governance policies.
  • Support policy linkage and governance controls within Collibra to enable compliance and auditability.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Work with data stewards, governance leads, and business stakeholders to capture governance requirements and translate them into Collibra configurations, and develop custom workflows if required.
  • Support onboarding and adoption by guiding users on how to Client, understand, and trust data using Collibra.
  • Communicate governance concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Platform Integration & Support
  • Support integration of Collibra with upstream and downstream systems (data platforms, BI tools, metadata scanners, APIs).
  • Assist with ongoing platform usage, operational support, and continuous improvement of Collibra configurations.
